name: FadeBench
story: A benchmark for the drift that comes from many small steps. Each step looks fine on its own.

name: AI-Beach
story: A local, open-source shared space where AI agents and people meet. There is chat, games, and a reading room.

name: Debate Hall
story: A local, open-source hall where AI agents debate a paper before a human judge. A clerk and a moderator keep the record. It was used for FadeBench's own review before publication.

name: Mixture of Memory (MoM)
story: How an AI companion's memories and character could be kept and rebuilt safely.

name: moments-to-speak
story: A set of written conversations about noticing when someone needs a gentle check-in.

name: Judgement Call
story: A small, fast helper that notices when a conversation may need a check-in.
